goal.insight: Show the 3-tier architecture (Access, Business, Data) with 12 services arranged by layer, making the tier boundaries and service groupings visually distinct

Encode connection types using visual differentiation: solid lines for synchronous calls, dashed lines for asynchronous/message-queue-mediated calls, and distinct colors or line weights for service-mesh sidecar proxied connections
Highlight services with the highest number of inbound and outbound connections to reveal dependency complexity hotspots, especially at the Business layer
Visually distinguish shared infrastructure components (message queue, cache, databases) from application services, showing how multiple services converge on these shared resources
Display observability and service-mesh components (tracing, metrics, logging, sidecar proxies) as an overlay or annotation layer that spans across all three tiers
